description: Review queue only. Null judgments are not reviews and are never merged into semantic scores.

cases.question: How many subjects are Enrolled or Randomized by treatment arm?
cases.sql:
SELECT sub.treatment_arm, COUNT(DISTINCT sub.subject_id) AS enrolled_or_randomized_count
FROM subjects AS sub
WHERE sub.screening_status IN ('Enrolled', 'Randomized')
GROUP BY sub.treatment_arm;

cases.question: How many subjects have enrolled at each site?
cases.sql:
SELECT st.site_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sub.subject_id) AS enrolled_subjects
FROM sites AS st
LEFT JOIN subjects AS sub ON st.site_id = sub.site_id
AND sub.screening_status IN ('Enrolled', 'Randomized')
GROUP BY st.site_id;

cases.question: How many scheduled visits were missed last month?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(visit_id) AS missed_visits FROM visits WHERE status = 'Missed' AND planned_date >= DATE('now', '-1 month')

cases.question: Compare serious adverse-event rates across treatment arms.
cases.sql:
SELECT sub.treatment_arm, COUNT(DISTINCT sub.subject_id) AS total_subjects, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.subject_id) AS serious_adverse_events
FROM subjects AS sub
JOIN adverse_events AS ae ON sub.subject_id = ae.subject_id
WHERE ae.serious = true
GROUP BY sub.treatment_arm;
